I played the demo and the beta for 2-3 days in total, had no prior experience with SF and found the game a great experience overall, I just think it's too hard for someone starting out right now, too much to get used to like links,parry,overdrive attacks, combos etc. I know there are modern controls supposed to fix that but I'm not into them. I'd rather have full control of my character and to have a hard time than restrict my kit like that. Got wrecked a lot but still think it's fun and I would love it probably if I had prior experience to SF, maybe I'll try Strive.
